notes.pres24: two-party Harris share (d2) and margin (D - R, % of all presidential votes). 2024 lines: each county's official total split over its districts by the 2024 precinct results (each precinct assigned to the House district on its ballot); counties inside one district are exact. method: county (all counties whole), precinct, population (a split county without precinct-district data, split by 2020 population).
notes.pres20: 2020 county totals split over districts like each county's 2024 votes of the same party (approximation: assumes the within-county pattern of 2024; the district swing is a weighted mix of county swings).
notes.crosswalk: redrawn states: the (county x 2024 district) pieces above split to 2026 districts by 2020 census block population (approximation: uniform vote within each piece).
notes.house24: MEDSL 2024 precinct returns summed by district (votes; d2 = top D / (top D + top R)); winner, uncontested (one candidate with >= 1 % of votes), incumbent from FEC's 2024 ballot list.
notes.swing_house: 2024 minus 2022 House margin, only where the lines did not change (not AL, GA, LA, NC, NY) and both races were D vs R.
